```yaml
name: Publish Connectors Prerelease Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR Number'
        required: true
        type: number

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Get PR information
        id: get_pr_info
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=pr_branch::$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_title::$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} --json title --jq .title)"

      - name: Post start comment
        run: |
          gh pr comment ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} --body "Starting pre-release connector build for PR #${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} (${{ steps.get_pr_info.outputs.pr_branch }}). Expected image tag format: {version}-dev.${{ steps.get_pr_info.outputs.pr_branch | sha1 | truncate(length=10) }}"

      - name: Call publish_connectors.yml workflow
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          release-type: pre-release
          ref: ${{ steps.get_pr_info.outputs.pr_branch }}

      - name: Post completion comment
        run: |
          if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            gh pr comment ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} --body ":white_check_mark: Pre-release connector build completed successfully."
          else
            gh pr comment ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} --body ":x: Pre-release connector build failed."
          fi
```
